newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn's Stark says markets to offer forex clarity.
newsitem.headline: Bonn's Stark says markets to offer forex clarity.

text.p: The state secretary in Germany's finance ministry Juergen Stark on Wednesday declined to comment directly on the situation in foreign exchange markets.
Asked by reporters as he arrived to speak at an event in Frankfurt on capital markets whether he could clarify the market situation, he said, "The markets will offer clarity".
The mark has fallen sharply against the dollar in recent days.
